room_rent.note: BharatX is modular; default is no restriction; customer picks coverages; room rent can be modified via Optional Cover 21

copayment.note: Zone-based 10% co-pay if hospitalized in higher zone than declared; modular plan may vary

sub_limits.display: Modular; modern treatments 50% SI (waivable); road ambulance 1% SI max ₹10k
sub_limits.note: Depends on coverages chosen; modern treatments 50% SI unless Advance Care opted

initial_waiting.note: BharatX shows both 7 days and 30 days options in plan chart; customer chooses

ped_waiting.note: BharatX shows both 3 years and 1 year options; best achievable is 12 months

specific_disease_waiting.note: BharatX shows both 2 years and 1 year options; best achievable is 12 months

maternity.note: BharatX is modular; Section 4 Maternity Wallet or Optional Cover 9 can be chosen; 9-month wait for Section 4

cumulative_bonus.note: BharatX plan chart shows cumulative bonus options ranging from 5% up to 25% per year with max up to 600%; exact rate depends on option chosen

restoration.note: BharatX shows unlimited reinstatement or once per policy period options; depends on chosen coverage

pre_hosp.note: BharatX plan chart shows 30/60/90/120 days options

post_hosp.note: BharatX plan chart shows 60/90/120/180 days options; pre-hosp always less than post-hosp

ambulance.note: 0.25% of SI max INR 10,000 shown in plan chart for BharatX

global_cover.note: Worldwide Coverage available as modular choice in BharatX; not available if NRI Benefit opted

notable_exclusions: Fully modular plan; exclusions depend on coverages chosen; consumables not inbuilt; tobacco-related oral/respiratory cancer excluded; hormone replacement therapy excluded
optional_riders: All 25 optional covers available; customer picks and chooses coverages including Consumables, OPD, Maternity, Infertility, Advance Care, Medical Equipment, NRI Benefit, Infinite Cumulative Bonus
